assignment_rule: nearest medoid within a radius covering 95% of that cluster's members; outside every radius -> UNASSIGNED
discovery: unsupervised — DBSCAN over DSAA fingerprints, no label used at any point
labelling: post-hoc interpretation of each cluster's dominant Signal-1 attribution; naming a discovered cluster does not make the discovery supervised
